news.title: Powering the nuclear comeback: Three universities form consortium to close a critical workforce gap
news.summary_en: Three powerhouse public research universities — Arizona State University (ASU), Purdue University and the University of Tennessee Knoxville (UTK) — have united to create the New Nuclear Academic Consortium.

news.title: Wearable AI device by ECE's Hussain aims to improve epinephrine injections to treat anaphylaxis
news.summary_en: Patent-pending device seeks to administer drug rapidly by monitoring, acting on physiological indicators

news.title: Finding her place among the stars
news.summary_en: AAE junior Olivia DeScipio went from feeling like an outsider to excelling in her pursuit of a career in human spaceflight and STEM outreach.

news.title: MSE's Strachan named APS fellow for research on materials under extreme conditions
news.summary_en: Alejandro (Ale) Strachan, Reilly Professor of Materials Engineering in Purdue University's School of Materials Engineering, has been named a 2026 Fellow of the American Physical Society (APS) through the Topical Group on Compression of Condensed Matter.
